summary.name: clip'M
summary.one_liner: A clipboard manager for Apple silicon Macs, ported from the original ClipMenu, with history search, snippets, live previews, and text actions.
use_cases: Find a line of text copied earlier in the day
Search clipboard history for a screenshot by its appearance
Store and paste reusable email replies or addresses
Preview clips before pasting the right screenshot or document
Transform copied text to uppercase, lowercase, or decoded URL before pasting
Keep clipboard history in the menu bar on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: clip'M is a clipboard history manager that lives in the macOS menu bar. Pressing / starts instant filtering of clipboard history, and an image-only search mode finds screenshots. Users can organize reusable text snippets into folders and open them from the same menu. Hovering a clip or history group shows a live preview of text, screenshots, and documents. Built-in actions such as uppercase, lowercase, and URL decoding can transform a clip before pasting, and users can write their own actions.
notable: Port of the long-running ClipMenu app, rebuilt natively for Apple silicon Macs
Image-only search and live previews for clips
Open source under the MIT license
caveats: Mac App Store version requires a manual ⌘V after selecting an item; the direct download uses Accessibility permission to press ⌘V automatically
Mac App Store version cannot use Accessibility features beyond strict accessibility needs
